qualifier_in_source: "Do NOT generalize targeted discounting as a sustainable-growth strategy" — acquired cohort does not survive first renewal cycle

judgments.note: Explicitly repeats the prohibition and cohort renewal failure.
States it is not a sustainable growth lever; cohort fails renewal.
States acquired cohort fails to persist through renewal.
"Poor renewal persistence" conveys cohort does not survive renewal.
"Weak renewals" is a metric descriptor; no prohibition or cohort failure.
"Renewals weak" only; no stated limit on generalizing the strategy.
